name: @arena/product-flows
description: Guided product workflow definitions + flow runtime for Arena (Work Order B008; issue #80): the ordered, versioned steps of the capability-development guided flow (start case -> frame capability gap -> compose task -> run -> observe -> evaluate -> decide), each bound to the canonical A005 Capability Case lifecycle states it is valid from/to, and a runtime that applies ONLY canonical lifecycle transitions through the B002 ControlPlaneRepository port (the in-memory fake is the local/demo posture). No parallel lifecycle, no parallel store: every transition is a @arena/capability-case pure function, every write is a repository insert/update with optimistic concurrency, and lifecycle violations surface the canonical typed errors verbatim. Pure + deterministic: flow definitions are frozen data and every timestamp/id is injected by the caller.
